item.title: Side Hustle Tax UK: When You Must Register for Self Assessment
item.description: Earning from a side hustle in the UK? Learn when the £1,000 trading allowance runs out, the 5 October registration deadline, how much tax you'll actually pay, and what HMRC already knows from selling platforms.

item.title: Second Job Tax UK: How Much Tax Will You Pay in 2025/26?
item.description: How tax codes, Income Tax and National Insurance actually work across two jobs in the UK — with worked examples and common myths debunked.

item.title: How Compound Interest Works (And How to Use It to Build Wealth)
item.description: A complete guide to compound interest with real worked examples, the rule of 72, and UK savings options.

item.title: What Is a Good Rental Yield in the UK? A Landlord's Guide
item.description: Rental yield is the key metric every UK landlord needs to know. Learn what counts as a good yield, how to calculate it, and which UK cities offer the best returns.

item.title: How to Pay Off Debt Fast: Snowball vs Avalanche
item.description: A complete guide to the debt snowball and debt avalanche methods with worked examples and UK-specific tips.

item.title: IR35 Explained: What Every UK Contractor Needs to Know
item.description: IR35 is one of the most misunderstood tax rules for UK contractors. This guide explains what it is, how HMRC determines your status, and what you can do about it.

item.title: How Much Do You Need to Retire in the UK? A Realistic Guide
item.description: How much money do you actually need to retire comfortably in the UK? This guide covers the PLSA retirement standards, the 4% rule, and how to calculate your own target.

item.title: UK Stamp Duty in 2025: How Much Will You Pay When Buying a Home?
item.description: Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) is one of the biggest costs of buying property in England. This guide explains the current rates, thresholds, and who qualifies for relief.

item.title: How to Get the Best Exchange Rate When Sending Money Abroad

item.title: APR Explained: The Only Number That Matters When Borrowing
item.description: A complete guide to APR — what it includes, where it misleads you, and how to use it correctly.

item.title: How to Calculate Body Fat Percentage (And What It Actually Means)
item.description: Body fat percentage tells you more about your health than BMI alone. Learn how to calculate it, what the healthy ranges are, and the most accurate measurement methods.

item.title: How Much Water Should You Drink Per Day? The Real Answer
item.description: The '8 glasses a day' rule is outdated. Your actual water needs depend on your weight, activity level, and climate. Learn how to calculate your personal hydration target.

item.title: Best Sleep Schedule by Age: How Much Sleep Do You Actually Need?
item.description: Sleep needs change across your lifetime. From newborns to older adults, here's exactly how much sleep each age group needs and how to build a schedule that works.

item.title: What Is a UUID? How Unique IDs Are Generated and When to Use Them
item.description: UUIDs are 128-bit identifiers used everywhere in software — databases, APIs, file systems. Learn what they are, the difference between UUID versions, and when to use them.

item.title: How to Generate a Strong Password (And Actually Remember It)

item.title: How to Format JSON: A Developer's Complete Guide
item.description: JSON is the universal data format for APIs, configs, and web apps. Learn the syntax rules, how to format and validate it, common mistakes, and how to work with it in every major language.

item.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit: How Temperature Conversion Works
item.description: Converting between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin is easier once you understand the formulas. Learn the quick mental math tricks and the science behind temperature scales.

item.title: Miles to Kilometres: Distance Conversion Guide
item.description: Whether you're travelling, running, or converting UK road signs, here's everything you need to know about converting miles to kilometres — with formulas, tables, and mental maths shortcuts.
